# Command palette

Open the palette with `F1` and type a few letters of a command. **Key** is the default key from the keymap. **Hint** is the text the palette shows on the right.

## Commands added at run time

The palette also shows commands that are not listed here:

- **`User: <title>`** — your own shell commands from `~/.config/termocode/commands.json` (open it with **Open Config: User Commands**). See [config files](config-files.md).
- **`Ext: <title>`** — commands registered by Lua extensions in `~/.config/termocode/extensions/`. Bind one to a key with `"<key>": "ext:<command id>"` in `keymap.json`.
- Recently used commands move to the top of the list.
